say:2:1410458101:1.text: Explain yourself. What exactly has occurred?
say:2:1410458101:1.source_cn: 讲清楚，到底发生了什么事？

say:3:1410458102:0.text: Reporting, my lady... During the distribution of the Divine Dew today, a riot broke out!
say:3:1410458102:0.source_cn: 报告大人，今日分发恩典灵露的时候，发生了暴乱！

say:4:1410458103:0.text: A group of commoners rushed the platform and clashed with us. Amidst the chaos, others seized the Divine Dew...
say:4:1410458103:0.source_cn: 一群平民突然冲向台座，与我们发生了冲突，随后更多的平民...

say:5:1410458104:0.text: Worse still, those with Stigmas took part in the uprising as well.
say:5:1410458104:0.source_cn: 更令人震怒的是，那些身负惩罚印记的罪人也参与其中。

say:6:1410458105:0.text: Other guards are chasing these desecrators, but I was ordered to report this matter to you immediately.
say:6:1410458105:0.source_cn: 其他守卫正在追捕这些亵渎恩典之人，我奉命前来紧急通报此事。

say:7:1410458106:0.text: ... I understand. Go report this to Prince Ravion. He should be at Wisteria Hall.
say:7:1410458106:0.source_cn: ……我了解了，你快去汇报给沙利叶殿下。殿下应该在紫藤会...

say:8:1410458107:0.text: Merlin and I will handle the commoners' district.
say:8:1410458107:0.source_cn: 我跟梅林先赶去平民区处理此事。
say:8:1410458107:0.male: Merlin and I will handle the commoners' district.
say:8:1410458107:0.female: Merlin and I will handle the commoners' district.

say:10:1410458109:1.text: This is unexpected. How did this happen so suddenly?
say:10:1410458109:1.source_cn: 太奇怪了，怎么会突然发生这种事？
say:10:1410458109:1.male: This is unexpected. How did this happen so suddenly?
say:10:1410458109:1.female: This is unexpected. How did this happen so suddenly?

choice_prompt:11:1410458109.text: This is unexpected. How did this happen so suddenly?
choice_prompt:11:1410458109.source_cn: 太奇怪了，怎么会突然发生这种事？
choice_prompt:11:1410458109.male: This is unexpected. How did this happen so suddenly?
choice_prompt:11:1410458109.female: This is unexpected. How did this happen so suddenly?

say:12:1410458110:1.text: I see. Caiden's plight has ignited their anger.
say:12:1410458110:1.source_cn: ……我明白了，凯登的遭遇点燃了他们的愤怒。
say:12:1410458110:1.male: I see. Caiden's plight has ignited their anger.
say:12:1410458110:1.female: I see. Caiden's plight has ignited their anger.

say:13:1410458112:1.text: I can understand their anger... but duty is duty. I will bring them to justice.
say:13:1410458112:1.source_cn: 平民的不满早已积压恒久。我能理解他们的绝望，但职责所在...
say:13:1410458112:1.male: I can understand their anger... but duty is duty. I will bring them to justice.
say:13:1410458112:1.female: I can understand their anger... but duty is duty. I will bring them to justice.

say:14:1410458113:1.text: Once the situation is under control, I will report truthfully to Prince Ravion. This is no matter that can be solved by force alone—we must address the root cause.
say:14:1410458113:1.source_cn: 等事态平息，我会向沙利叶殿下如实相告。这样的暴乱不能只...
say:14:1410458113:1.male: Once the situation is under control, I will report truthfully to Prince Ravion. This is no matter that can be solved by force alone—we must address the root cause.
say:14:1410458113:1.female: Once the situation is under control, I will report truthfully to Prince Ravion. This is no matter that can be solved by force alone—we must address the root cause.

choice_prompt:15:1410458113.text: Once the situation is under control, I will report truthfully to Prince Ravion. This is no matter that can be solved by force alone—we must address the root cause.
choice_prompt:15:1410458113.source_cn: 等事态平息，我会向沙利叶殿下如实相告。这样的暴乱不能只靠镇压，得从根源解决。
choice_prompt:15:1410458113.male: Once the situation is under control, I will report truthfully to Prince Ravion. This is no matter that can be solved by force alone—we must address the root cause.
choice_prompt:15:1410458113.female: Once the situation is under control, I will report truthfully to Prince Ravion. This is no matter that can be solved by force alone—we must address the root cause.

say:16:1410458114:1.text: Don't underestimate the ruthlessness of the law, Merlin. If this isn't resolved properly, innocent lives will be lost.
say:16:1410458114:1.source_cn: 别低估律法的无情。如果这件事不能够妥善解决的话，无辜的...
say:16:1410458114:1.male: Don't underestimate the ruthlessness of the law, Merlin. If this isn't resolved properly, innocent lives will be lost.
say:16:1410458114:1.female: Don't underestimate the ruthlessness of the law, Merlin. If this isn't resolved properly, innocent lives will be lost.

say:17:1410458115:1.text: ... The Queen may be merciful, but her justice is unforgiving.
say:17:1410458115:1.source_cn: ……女王不仅是仁慈的，也是冷酷的。
say:17:1410458115:1.male: ... The Queen may be merciful, but her justice is unforgiving.
say:17:1410458115:1.female: ... The Queen may be merciful, but her justice is unforgiving.

say:18:1410458116:1.text: The worst-case scenario is that, for a time, no one in the commoners' district will receive the Divine Dew. That would be a real tragedy...
say:18:1410458116:1.source_cn: 最坏的结果可能是，一段时间内，平民区所有人都无法获得恩...
say:18:1410458116:1.male: The worst-case scenario is that, for a time, no one in the commoners' district will receive the Divine Dew. That would be a real tragedy...
say:18:1410458116:1.female: The worst-case scenario is that, for a time, no one in the commoners' district will receive the Divine Dew. That would be a real tragedy...

say:19:1410458117:1.text: We cannot allow this situation to escalate any further. Come, we must quell this rebellion swiftly.
say:19:1410458117:1.source_cn: 我们不能让形势彻底失控。走吧，必须尽快平息这场暴乱。
say:19:1410458117:1.male: We cannot allow this situation to escalate any further. Come, we must quell this rebellion swiftly.
say:19:1410458117:1.female: We cannot allow this situation to escalate any further. Come, we must quell this rebellion swiftly.

choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 为什么不放他们一马呢？

choice:11:0:1.text: Let me tell you about Caiden...
choice:11:0:1.male: Let me tell you about Caiden...
choice:11:0:1.female: Let me tell you about Caiden...

say:21:1410458111:1.text: Their dissatisfaction has festered for much longer than any of us may have realized.
say:21:1410458111:1.source_cn: 这不是一天两天了，他们应该也习惯了。
say:21:1410458111:1.male: Their dissatisfaction has festered for much longer than any of us may have realized.
say:21:1410458111:1.female: Their dissatisfaction has festered for much longer than any of us may have realized.

choice:11:1:2.text: Are you really surprised by this?
choice:11:1:2.male: Are you really surprised by this?
choice:11:1:2.female: Are you really surprised by this?
